create.name: The Pattern
create.bio:
The Pattern is a personal astrology app made by Pattern Home, Inc. From a user's date, time and place of birth it builds a natal chart and turns it into plain-language readings, avoiding the usual astrological jargon. Its makers say they draw on long study of astrology and present the readings as material for self-reflection rather than forecasts or verdicts, so that users can recognise their own strengths and difficulties more clearly.

The core reading, called Your Pattern, describes character traits and tendencies. Transits follow the planetary cycles a person is moving through, past, present and to come, and a Time Travel tool shows the astrology of any chosen date. Bonds compares two charts to explore friendships and romantic relationships, with a separate feature for the changing cycles of a couple, and the app also carries a daily reading, audio episodes and new-moon guides through each month. Newer additions include an AI conversation feature informed by the user's chart and a feature for meeting people with compatible charts. The company's website offers a free natal chart calculator using whole-sign houses, and the app itself is free to download with paid tiers inside it.

free_resources.title: Your Natal Chart
free_resources.description: A free birth chart calculator on the company's site: enter a name, birth date, time and place to see a chart drawn in the whole-sign house system, with a short note on why charts differ between house systems.
